description.en: Learn the essentials: wolves, information, and two kinds of card exchange.
description.zh: 两狼、预言家、强盗、捣蛋鬼、村民，学习查看与换牌的基本玩法。

description.en: Two wolves with a seer, robber, troublemaker, drunk, insomniac, and villager.
description.zh: 双狼搭配预言家、强盗、捣蛋鬼、酒鬼、失眠者及村民，信息与交换并重。

description.en: A Mystic Wolf, a shield, and a witch make the night harder to untangle.
description.zh: 秘术狼、守夜人的保护与女巫的换牌，让夜晚的身份变化更加丰富。

description.en: Explore marks, infection, love, and card swaps during dusk and night.
description.zh: 体验黄昏标记、感染、爱情和夜间交换，身份之外还有另一层秘密。

description.en: Two aliens face unusual information roles. Uses the published-rule adaptation shown in the room.
description.zh: 双外星人搭配特殊信息角色，采用房间显示的公开规则改编版。

description.en: Add an Aura Seer, Prince, and Apprentice Tanner to a familiar wolf table.
description.zh: 在经典狼人牌局中加入灵光预言家、王子和见习皮匠的特殊目标。

description.en: A new cast of secret teams, unusual powers, and an innocent bystander.
description.zh: 以全新的秘密阵营、超能力与无辜路人展开一夜推理。

description.en: House preset: two wolves, familiar swaps, and an Insomniac to check one final card.
description.zh: 自选组合：双狼搭配预言家、强盗与捣蛋鬼，失眠者在清晨核对自己的牌。

description.en: House preset: two wolves and their Minion face paired Masons, a Seer, and shifting cards.
description.zh: 自选组合：双狼与爪牙迎战两位共济会成员和预言家，强盗、捣蛋鬼与酒鬼带来身份变化。

description.en: House preset: three wolves and a Minion; two seers and three swapping roles keep everyone guessing.
description.zh: 自选组合：三狼与爪牙对阵预言家、见习预言家，强盗、捣蛋鬼和女巫让身份不断变化。

description.en: House preset: three wolves, a Minion, paired Masons, and a Hunter make claims and the final vote matter.
description.zh: 自选组合：三狼、爪牙、两位共济会成员与猎人同场，查看和换牌之后还要谨慎投票。

description.en: House preset: four wolves and a Minion meet a Sentinel, two seers, card swaps, and a late Revealer.
description.zh: 自选组合：四狼与爪牙对阵哨兵、两位预言家及换牌角色，揭示者在夜末留下公开线索。

description.en: Advanced house preset: four wolf cards including the Alpha, a Minion, paired Masons, and several swaps. The extra center wolf is added automatically.
description.zh: 进阶自选组合：四张狼牌含狼王，搭配爪牙、双共济会成员与多种换牌；狼王的额外中央狼牌会自动加入。

description.en: Advanced house preset: five wolf cards plus a Minion, shields, inspections, and four village swapping roles. One monster faction; Alpha adds its reserve automatically.
description.zh: 进阶自选组合：五张狼牌与爪牙，搭配保护、查验及四种村庄换牌角色。仅狼人一种怪物阵营；狼王储备牌自动加入。

description.en: Advanced house preset: wolves, vampires, and aliens share the table with card and mark swaps. Multi-faction voting may apply; uses the app's Alien adaptation.
description.zh: 高复杂度自选组合：狼人、吸血鬼与外星人同场，牌与标记分别流转；可能采用多阵营投票，外星人使用本应用的改编规则。

description.en: Advanced house preset: five wolf cards and a Minion face paired Masons and a Village Idiot rotation. Alpha adds a reserve; the Hunter raises the voting stakes.
description.zh: 进阶自选组合：五张狼牌与爪牙对阵双共济会成员，村庄傻瓜可轮转身份；狼王自动增加储备牌，猎人让投票更有变数。

description.en: Advanced house preset: four wolves, a Minion, and a Squire against shields, investigators, and five village swapping roles. Track information as carefully as cards.
description.zh: 进阶自选组合：四狼、爪牙与狼人侍从对阵保护、查验及五种村庄换牌角色，既要追踪牌，也要核对情报的时机。

description.en: Advanced house preset: three monster factions, a protective Sentinel, and extra center information. Card and mark swaps complicate multi-faction voting; Alien rules are adapted.
description.zh: 高复杂度自选组合：三种怪物阵营、哨兵保护与额外中央牌情报；换牌和标记变化增加多阵营投票的难度，外星人规则采用应用改编版。

description.en: Advanced house preset: five wolf cards, a Minion, and a Squire; paired Masons, two seers, and several swaps supply competing stories. Alpha adds its reserve automatically.
description.zh: 进阶自选组合：五张狼牌、爪牙与狼人侍从，搭配双共济会成员、两位预言家及多种换牌，形成交错证词；狼王储备牌自动加入。

description.en: Advanced house preset: the full five-card wolf pack and two allies face Masons, shields, inspections, and five village swapping roles. One monster faction; Alpha reserve added automatically.
description.zh: 进阶自选组合：五张狼牌与两位狼队盟友对阵共济会成员、保护、查验及五种村庄换牌角色。仅狼人一种怪物阵营；狼王储备牌自动加入。

description.en: Advanced house preset: wolves, vampires, aliens, Love marks, shields, and card/mark swaps. Several factions may change the vote and victory rules; uses the app's Alien adaptation.
description.zh: 高复杂度自选组合：狼人、吸血鬼、外星人、爱情标记、护盾与牌／标记交换；多阵营可能改变投票和胜利规则，外星人采用应用改编版。
